description: A brick of stacked supercapacitors in a ribbed grey shell, heavier than it has any right to be. A charge indicator on the end cap reads full, or reads nothing, and has no opinion about anything in between. Handling instructions are moulded into the plastic in six languages and all six of them begin with the word DO NOT.
